parameters.content:
## Satyer Deals Auto — নাজিরাবাজার (সত্যের প্রহর) — INACTIVE
Automated Bangla content business: 1 deal post per day, 09:30 Asia/Dhaka.
Flow: Pick Deal (first unposted deal from /agency/deals-queue.json, dedup vs /agency/deals-log.json) -> Gemini Writer (short Bangla post, NO invented prices/discounts) -> Facebook Post (link = Daraz affiliate hyperlink) -> Log Deal.
DEAL SOURCE — HONEST LIMIT (researched 10 Nov 2026): Daraz offers NO public deals RSS feed and NO affiliate API. Affiliates get tracking hyperlinks from the Daraz affiliate dashboard. The Daraz Open Platform API is SELLER-only. So deals come from the CURATED QUEUE /agency/deals-queue.json that Jony refills himself — 10 entries = 10 days. This is NOT fully automatic deal discovery. Do not pretend otherwise.
KEYS TO PASTE (in n8n UI, never in chat):
1. 'Gemini Writer' node: header x-goog-api-key = your Gemini API key.
2. 'Facebook Post' node: replace PASTE_PAGE_ID_HERE in the URL with the নাজিরাবাজার Page ID.
3. 'Facebook Post' node: header Authorization Bearer PASTE_FB_PAGE_TOKEN_HERE = Page Access Token.
4. Daraz affiliate: sign up free at daraz.com.bd/daraz-affiliate-program, copy the FULL affiliate hyperlink for each product from the dashboard into the queue entry's affiliate_url. Do NOT buy through your own link. Cookie 7 days, last click wins. Commission up to ~18% by category, paid in BDT, minimum payout BDT 2,500.
Workflow stays INACTIVE until keys are pasted, the queue is filled, AND Jony says activate.
Tag: deals-auto (separate from news-auto and the video pipeline).
